description: Acquisition ledger for canonical states that have dual-host smoke coverage but no physical frame or official visual evidence. Routes are semantic: exact tap coordinates must be chosen from a fresh framebuffer immediately before each tap.
invariants: Capture only the disposable scratch preset unless a state is independent of preset content.
Record a clean Grid framebuffer and preset identity before and after every route.
Never confirm delete, reset, update, shutdown, or recovery actions while collecting a dialog or menu frame.
Restore the original screen, scene, mode, preset identity, and dirty state after every capture.
Accept a physical frame only after two consecutive 800x480 captures are byte-identical.

states.route: Grid > Preset menu > Delete
states.capture: Delete confirmation before any destructive confirmation
states.restore: Cancel the dialog and verify the original clean Grid

states.route: I/O Settings > select OUT 1/L or OUT 2/R
states.capture: Analog output detail
states.restore: Close I/O Settings and verify Grid

states.route: I/O Settings > select SEND or RETURN connector
states.capture: Send/Return detail
states.restore: Close I/O Settings and verify Grid

states.route: I/O Settings > select headphone output
states.capture: Headphones detail
states.restore: Close I/O Settings and verify Grid

states.route: Locate the native Global Input Gate/Bypass editor from the current CorOS UI
states.capture: Global input gate/bypass state without changing its value
states.restore: Close the editor and verify the original inhibited-module state

states.route: Empty Grid slot > device browser > Search
states.capture: Device search/results surface
states.restore: Close the browser without adding a block

states.route: Empty Grid slot > device browser > Favorites/Recent
states.capture: Favorites/Recent device surface
states.restore: Close the browser without adding a block

states.route: Open an existing Neural Capture block in a disposable preset
states.capture: Neural Capture block parameter editor
states.restore: Close the editor without changing parameters

states.route: Open a Virtual Device > Presets > Save
states.capture: Virtual Device preset save editor before saving
states.restore: Cancel and verify the preset remains clean

states.route: Grid > long-press an existing block
states.capture: Block contextual actions
states.restore: Dismiss without choosing an action

states.route: Use a bounded test signal to reproduce the native clipping warning
states.capture: Clipping warning at safe monitor volume
states.restore: Remove the signal and verify meters return to idle

states.route: Load a disposable DSP-stress preset that is known to produce the native warning
states.capture: DSP capacity warning before accepting any edit
states.restore: Reload the original clean scratch preset

states.route: Directory > long-press a disposable preset or item
states.capture: Directory item contextual actions
states.restore: Dismiss without choosing an action

states.route: Grid/Preset menu > New Neural Capture
states.capture: Capture-type selection before starting calibration
states.restore: Cancel the wizard and verify Grid

states.route: Settings > Support
states.capture: Support screen with identifiers redacted only in published evidence
states.restore: Return to Grid

states.route: Settings > Wi-Fi
states.capture: Wi-Fi screen without joining or forgetting a network
states.restore: Return to Grid; do not alter network state

states.route: Acquire during a user-initiated supported CorOS update or from an official full-frame source
states.capture: Update progress
states.restore: Never initiate or interrupt firmware update solely for corpus acquisition

states.route: Settings > Storage / Factory Reset
states.capture: Storage screen before any reset confirmation
states.restore: Return to Grid without confirming reset

states.route: Settings > Device information
states.capture: Device information with identifiers redacted only in published evidence
states.restore: Return to Grid

states.route: Settings > Diagnostics
states.capture: Diagnostics overview without running destructive or long-lived tests
states.restore: Return to Grid

states.route: Enter Recovery Mode using the documented hardware boot gesture
states.capture: Recovery options before selecting an operation
states.restore: Exit or reboot normally; verify CorOS and the scratch preset after startup

states.route: Open Edit Details or New Folder text entry
states.capture: On-screen keyboard with a non-sensitive disposable value
states.restore: Cancel text entry and verify no rename/folder creation

states.route: Open a reversible action that presents the native confirmation overlay
states.capture: Confirmation overlay before acceptance
states.restore: Cancel the action and verify original state

states.route: Identify a harmless rejected operation that produces the native error overlay
states.capture: Error overlay with no persistent device mutation
states.restore: Dismiss and verify Grid and preset identity

states.route: Start a supported read-heavy operation such as backup preparation or catalog refresh
states.capture: Busy/progress overlay while the operation is active
states.restore: Allow the operation to finish normally and verify Grid
